strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch : a bɛ sisan keybox lajɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni Google ka revocation list (CRL) ye ani ka source caman kɛ k’a lajɛ fo ka keybox valide sɔrɔ, ni automatique backup ye ani Google baarakɛminɛnw daminɛni kokura. A bɛ boli pompi kelen-kelen bɛɛ kan ani a mago bɛ ɛntɛrinɛti la (miniti 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox ka bɔ réseau la : a bɛ keybox dɔ telesarse ka bɔ marayɔrɔ ofisiyali la (GitHub) k’a mara /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. A mago bɛ ɛntɛrinɛti la wa a bɛ miniti 1-3 ta. A bɛ Kɛ ni smart fetch (smart fetch) ma Se walima ni keybox (kɔlɔsilikɛlan) b’a Yɛlɛma bolo la.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP sɛgɛsɛgɛli : a bɛ Remote Key Provisioning modulu minnu bɛ sɔrɔ , olu lajɛ , ka TEE seereyaw sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ , ka KmInstallKeybox baarakɛminɛn cogoya jira . A tɛ foyi Changé — minɛn cogoya jiracogo gansan.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine sɛgɛsɛgɛli (kalan dɔrɔn): a bɛ Widevine hakɛ jiralanw jira (L1/L3) ka bɔ dumsiw la, DRM (IDM) kilisi-dosiyɛri sɔrɔli, ani sistɛmu nafa minnu bɛ tali kɛ o la. A tɛ foyi sɛmɛntiya fewu.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Gafe RKP labɛnni : boli sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh gafe . A bɛ seereyaw koɲɛw ɲɛnabɔ ni otomatiki tɛmɛsira ma ɲɛ. Boli bɛɛ bɛ ɲɛtaa/dɛsɛ sira jɛlen dɔ sɛbɛn.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Dafalen RKP labɛn : boli sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh dafalen . A bɛ kɛsu gɛlɛnw ɲɛnabɔ ani a bɛ waati jan ta. O nɔ jɛlen dɔ bɛ bɔ a laban na.
strings.mdGmsReset: • GMS lasegin : a bɛ Play Store ni Google baarakɛminɛnw (GMS+GSF) kunnafoniw saniya ani ka minɛn in daminɛ kokura a yɛrɛma . Ka ɲɛsin seereya kuncɛbaya dɔrɔn ma — a tɛ maga i ka fotow walima i ka dosiyew la abada.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification : a bɛ RKP seereyaw seereya cogoya lajɛ minɛn in na ani ka seereyaw nafaw lasegin ni mago bɛ a la. A tɛ maga baarakɛlaw ka kunnafoniw na.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER dilan : a bɛ Google baarakɛminɛnw karamɔgɔya (SOTER ) koɲɛw ɲɛnabɔ minnu ɲɛsinnen bɛ minɛnw seereya ma . A bɛ Kɛ minɛn dɔw ye minnu bɛ u jigi da SOTER kan Play Integrity nɔ na.
strings.mdPifApply: • ka PIF: boli sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh fanga la. A bɛ bolokɔni sugandilen (sigida/kɔrɔlen) kɛ ka pif.prop/pif.json filenw kuraya. Jateminɛ jɛlen dɔ bɛ bɔ sɛbɛnfura kɔnɔ.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF sɛgɛsɛgɛli : a bɛ motɛri sigilen cogoya jira , bolokɔfɛfɛnw (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop ), ani sɛbɛnw . Check only — a tɛ foyi sɛmɛntiya.
strings.mdCanary: • Kanari kura : boli sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. A bɛ Canary Engine bɔko labanw ta walasa ka bɛn ni RKP seereyaw wajibiyalenw ye (san 2026 feburuyekalo).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Motɛri sɛgɛsɛgɛli : a bɛ TrickyStoreOSS cogoya lajɛ (pid, logs), keybox files (active vs user), device fingerprint real vs spoofed, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic jirali dɔrɔn.

strings.hintKbSlots: Module bɛ keybox yɔrɔ fila ɲɛnabɔ: fɔlɔ (senuman, a ma ko abada) ani filanan (backup). Nin tab in b’a jira ko slot min bɛ baara la, ka fɛɛrɛ caman sɛmɛntiya, walima ka filanan ka taa fɔlɔ la ni ɲinini jɛlen ye — ni backups ani log dafalen ye.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Dafalen sɛgɛsɛgɛli : a bɛ TEE kilisi doncogo lajɛ, gafemarayɔrɔ pikiri kɛli keystore2 kɔnɔ, a bɔli cogoya (CRL), lakanani-lisi datugucogo ani RKP cogoya. Kalan dɔrɔn — a tɛ foyi Changé.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Lakanali lisi bɛ jɔ kokura ka bɔ app installé bɛɛ la.
• Custom-ROM compatibility layer bɛ segin ka kɛ.
• active keybox bɛ segin ka appliquer.
• Google Play services bɛ daminɛ kokura.

Foyi tɛ bɔlen don ani kilisi fɔlɔ tɛ maga abada .

Tɛmɛ ?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots : a bɛ yɔrɔ fɔlɔ ni filanan cogoya jira ani ka fɛn diyabɔcogo caman wuli u ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ. fɔlɔ (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) bɛ lakana tuma bɛɛ wa a tɛ ko abada. Ka filanan kɔrɔta ka kɛ fɔlɔ ye , o bɛ dantigɛli jɛlen de wajibiya .
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:

• Foyi tɛ bɔ — baara bɛ se ka kɔsegin.
